title: Radio TV Programming
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a major element for any media producer.
Audience research is a major element for any media producer.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the first stage of television production.
Pre-production is the first stage of television production.

Fill in the blank: ______ are those programmes that are developed and produced by the local staff of a station or network while externally generated programmes are those developed in collaboration with other producers.

Internally generated programmes are those programmes that are developed and produced by the local staff of a station or network while externally generated programmes are those developed in collaboration with other producers.
fib: ______ is a medium used for transmitting and receiving moving images and sound.
The Nature of Television Broadcasting Television is a medium used for transmitting and receiving moving images and sound.
______ is the practice of arranging television or radio programmes in a daily, weekly, or season-long sequence.
Broadcast programming or scheduling is the practice of arranging television or radio programmes in a daily, weekly, or season-long sequence.
______ is the most important function of a radio or television stations the reason d'être of their operations.
Programming is the most important function of a radio or television stations the reason d'être of their operations.
